title: Testimony scroll
question: Sideways cards stays. Which of the three new scrolls should join it, or should sideways cards be the one we build?

options.label: Sideways cards
options.thesis: One cream band. Cards snap sideways: photo, title, writeup.
options.viewport: Thangaraj’s card is fully on screen. Poorvika and Creative Miracle peek in from the right, ready to scroll.
options.risk: The long Creative Miracle writeup has to live inside a card.

options.label: Reading rows
options.thesis: A continuous list. Each row is a photo, a title, and the full writeup.
options.viewport: Thangaraj, Poorvika, and the start of Creative Miracle are all on screen, separated by thin rules. Scroll down for the rest.
options.risk: Four full writeups make a long list before the sermons.

options.label: Photo reel
options.thesis: Photos scroll sideways. The title and writeup below belong to the photo in the center.
options.viewport: Thangaraj’s photo is large in the center. Poorvika peeks in from the right. His title and writeup sit under the reel.
options.risk: The words change only when the photos move, so a long story is easy to miss.

options.label: Words first
options.thesis: The writeup is the large type. The photo and title sit beside it.
options.viewport: Thangaraj’s paragraph fills the band, with a small photo and his title at the side. Poorvika’s words begin under a rule.
options.risk: The photos recede, so a visitor may not notice they can be opened.
